hook: Paradise–Dairy Farm skyway: *5.4 km*, pillars almost done
hook_b: Stuck at Paradise Circle daily? Your 5.4 km flyover is rising
tldr: HMDA's two elevated corridors through Secunderabad Cantonment are speeding up; most NH-44 pillars stand complete.

beats.what: HMDA says works on both Cantonment elevated corridors are gathering pace.
beats.why: Defence clearances came through, so demolition and digging began on undisputed stretches.
beats.care: Expect construction around Paradise, Begumpet and Rajiv Rahadari for a while; the payoff is a faster north exit.

cards.body: Corridor 1 runs on Rajiv Rahadari (SH-1), Gymkhana Grounds to Shamirpet ORR. HMDA has begun demolitions and digging where there's no dispute; walls at Gymkhana Grounds and defence sites are done after the Defence Ministry's clearance. Corridor 2 is a 5.4 km skyway on NH-44, Paradise Circle to Dairy Farm Road. Most of its first 20 pillars, Paradise/Balamrai to the Jagjivan Ram statue behind Begumpet Airport, are complete. Girders are being cast. A tunnel under the Begumpet runway still needs an Airports Authority of India nod.

cards.q: Do you cross Paradise or Rajiv Rahadari often?
Where does the 5.4 km NH-44 skyway end?
cards.why: It runs Paradise Circle to Dairy Farm Road.

viz.l: NH-44 skyway, Paradise to Dairy Farm Road
pillars on the first stretch, most complete

learn.t: Elevated corridor: a long flyover that carries through-traffic above a busy road, so local traffic below moves freer.

watch: AAI clearance for the Begumpet runway tunnel; no cost or completion date given.
